Privacy Policy

22 October 2026

Actual site interfaces

This site has no account, booking, ticket sales, contact form or email address for sending data. Operator and airline links lead to third-party services.

Technical data

The hosting provider may process IP addresses, browsers and page requests to deliver and protect the service. Analytics choices are stored in the browser, not a customer profile on this site.

Google Maps

Embedded maps on both homepages load when the map section is approached and make requests to Google. Technical data may reach the provider separately from this site’s analytics choice. Read Google’s privacy policy.

Analytics choices

Google Analytics loads only after an explicit analytics choice. It may use cookies and usage data and is not described as anonymous. If a permanent write fails, the site tries to retain refusal in this tab’s session storage or window-name state. While that refusal remains available, it overrides an old grant during same-site navigation and refresh. If neither fallback can be retained, only the current page is kept off; other tabs or a later page may retain an old grant. Unavailable storage reads keep Google Analytics off. Settings messages explain the available scope.

Hosting performance measurement

Cloudflare Web Analytics may add a separate browser beacon to measure page views and loading performance. The Google Analytics choice here does not disable that hosting measurement. A browser, content blocker or security policy may prevent the beacon or its requests; script presence alone does not prove successful delivery. Cloudflare documentation.

Browser controls

Reject or withdraw analytics in Cookie Settings, or clear site data and cookies in your browser. Language links do not store language preferences. The site code does not enable marketing tracking.

Google privacy · Cookie Settings

Supadio independent guide

Independent visitor information with no affiliation to the airport operator, airlines or government. No flight-status feed, ticket sales, bookings, account or contact form is provided.
